title: FLA import: motionSnap flag conflated with motionOrientToPath
description: In flash8-binary.ts around line 2364, a bit from the frame flags is labeled in a comment as 'motionTweenSnap / orient-to-path flag' and stored as motionOrientToPath. These are two distinct flags in Flash 8: motionOrientToPath (rotate object to follow path) and motionSnap (snap to guide path). Fix: determine the correct bit positions for each from flacomdoc (FlaFormatVersion.java / CPicFrame fields), add separate motionSnap?: boolean and motionOrientToPath?: boolean fields to Fla8Frame, decode them from the correct bits, forward both through flash8-import.ts, and ensure the core Frame model has both fields.
